outputRequestDescription.zh-CN: 必填：由 Agent 在每次工具调用时传入，说明你希望本次工具调用返回什么内容。绝不能省略、传 null 或空字符串。两种模式必须让 Agent 自主决策：需要完整原始结果时严格传 RAW（不区分大小写的三个 ASCII 字母）；需要节省 token 或只关心部分信息时，传一个描述性 prompt，让提炼模型提取你需要的那部分。对于 bash 等执行命令的工具，若只需要编译或测试的通过/失败和错误摘要，请使用描述性 prompt；需要完整日志、完整提取语法/参数/SQL，或逐行调试时才使用 RAW。不要使用“完整输出”或“完整提取”等自然语言作为值；该字段不会传给底层工具。
outputRequestDescription.en-US: Required: the Agent must pass this on every tool call to describe what it wants the tool to return. Never omit it, use null, or use an empty string. The Agent must actively choose one of two modes: use exactly RAW (the three ASCII letters, case-insensitive) when the full original result is needed; otherwise pass a descriptive prompt so the distiller extracts only the information you need, saving tokens. For command-execution tools such as bash, use a descriptive prompt when you only need pass/fail and an error summary; use RAW for full logs, complete syntax/parameter/SQL extraction, or line-by-line debugging. Do not use natural-language values such as "full output" or "complete extraction"; this field is removed before the underlying tool runs.

outputRequestSystemGuideline.zh-CN: 强制工具调用规则：每次调用任何带有 outputRequest 的工具时，Agent 都必须在 arguments 中通过 outputRequest 自主决策需要返回什么内容。绝不能省略、传 null 或空字符串。两种模式：需要完整原始输出时传 RAW；需要节省 token 或只提取部分信息时传描述性 outputRequest。RAW 必须是严格的三个 ASCII 字母。
outputRequestSystemGuideline.en-US: MANDATORY tool-call rule: whenever a tool exposes outputRequest, the Agent must include outputRequest in the arguments of every call and use it to actively decide what to return. Never omit it, use null, or use an empty string. Two modes: use RAW when the full original output is needed; use a descriptive outputRequest when you want to save tokens or extract only part of the result. RAW must be exactly the three ASCII letters.

configWarnings.zh-CN: 配置有警告，将以可用值打开：{warnings}
configWarnings.en-US: Configuration warnings; opening with usable values: {warnings}

configSaveFailed.zh-CN: 写入 Distill 配置失败，面板里的改动没有生效：{error}
configSaveFailed.en-US: Could not write the Distill configuration; the panel change did not take effect: {error}

interactiveOnly.zh-CN: 交互式设置需要在带 UI 的 Pi 会话中运行。
interactiveOnly.en-US: Interactive settings require a Pi session with UI.

noConfigurableTools.zh-CN: 当前没有可配置的工具。
noConfigurableTools.en-US: No configurable tools are currently available.

outputLimitExceeded.zh-CN: 输出超过 {maxChars} 个字符，完整内容已写入：{path}
outputLimitExceeded.en-US: Output exceeded {maxChars} chars and was written to: {path}

outputLimitWriteFailed.zh-CN: 无法写入超长输出临时文件，将返回截断内容：{error}
outputLimitWriteFailed.en-US: Failed to write oversized output to a temp file; returning truncated content: {error}

retryingSummary.zh-CN: 提炼发生{kind}，正在进行第 {retry}/{limit} 次重试：{error}

outputRequestUnavailable.zh-CN: 无法扩展工具 {tool} 的参数结构；outputRequest 不可用。
outputRequestUnavailable.en-US: Could not extend the {tool} parameter schema; outputRequest is unavailable.

extendOutputRequestFailed.zh-CN: 扩展 outputRequest 参数失败：{error}
extendOutputRequestFailed.en-US: Failed to extend the outputRequest parameter: {error}

panelDescEnabled.zh-CN: 总开关：关闭后不再为任何工具注入 outputRequest，也不调用提炼模型。
panelDescEnabled.en-US: Master switch: when off, no tool gets an outputRequest and the summarizer is never called.

panelDescModel.zh-CN: 调用提炼模型时使用的 provider/model；选「当前会话模型」表示跟随会话。
panelDescModel.en-US: provider/model used for distillation; pick the current session model to follow the session.

panelDescMinChars.zh-CN: 工具输出达到此字符数才调用提炼模型。
panelDescMinChars.en-US: Tool output must reach this length before the summarizer runs.

panelDescMaxChars.zh-CN: 提炼结果超过此字符数时写入文件，只把路径交给 Agent。
panelDescMaxChars.en-US: Summaries longer than this are written to a file and only the path is returned.

panelDescMaxOutputChars.zh-CN: 最终返回给 Agent 的内容超过此字符数时写入文件。
panelDescMaxOutputChars.en-US: Content above this length is written to a file before being returned.

panelDescTimeoutSeconds.zh-CN: 单次提炼模型调用最长等待时间。
panelDescTimeoutSeconds.en-US: Maximum wait for one summarizer call.

panelDescTimeoutRetryCount.zh-CN: 提炼因超时失败后的额外重试次数，0 表示不重试。
panelDescTimeoutRetryCount.en-US: Extra retries after a timeout, 0 disables them.

panelDescErrorRetryCount.zh-CN: 提炼因非超时异常失败后的额外重试次数，0 表示不重试。
panelDescErrorRetryCount.en-US: Extra retries after a non-timeout failure, 0 disables them.

panelDescMissedCompressionRatio.zh-CN: 没有 outputRequest 的输出超过最小字符数这么多倍时提醒。
panelDescMissedCompressionRatio.en-US: Warn when output without an outputRequest exceeds the minimum length by this factor.

panelDescSummarizeErrors.zh-CN: 工具返回错误且达到最小长度时是否仍调用提炼模型。
panelDescSummarizeErrors.en-US: Whether failed tools are still distilled once they reach the minimum length.

panelDescRenderEnabled.zh-CN: 是否在会话里显示提炼审计卡片。
panelDescRenderEnabled.en-US: Whether the distillation audit card is shown in the transcript.

panelDescRenderShowPrompt.zh-CN: 审计卡里是否显示本次调用的 outputRequest。
panelDescRenderShowPrompt.en-US: Whether the audit card includes the call's outputRequest.

panelDescRenderShowResult.zh-CN: 审计卡里是否显示提炼后的内容。
panelDescRenderShowResult.en-US: Whether the audit card includes the distilled content.

panelDescTool.zh-CN: 是否给 {tool} 注入 outputRequest 并提炼其结果；edit/write 未配置时默认关闭。
panelDescTool.en-US: Whether {tool} gets an outputRequest and result distillation; edit/write default to off.

configArgumentStatus.zh-CN: 打印当前配置，不打开面板。
configArgumentStatus.en-US: Print the current configuration instead of opening the panel.

configUnknownArgument.en-US: Unknown argument “{argument}”; available arguments: enable, disable, status.

commandDescription.zh-CN: 交互式配置工具输出提炼

statsCommandDescription.zh-CN: 查看本次会话的工具输出提炼统计
statsCommandDescription.en-US: Show tool-output distillation statistics for this session
